root_cause: web/src/tasks/TaskPopup.js onProjectChange() ran form.model.assigneeIds = [] unconditionally on any project change — wiping even assignees who are still members of the newly-selected project.
diff_summary: Keep assignees who are members of the newly-selected project (filter by project.members); clear only when no project is selected.
design_decisions: Sibling defect: CommentPopup.js has the same unconditional assignee-wipe on project change — recommend a separate ticket.
